label: Solo
short_description: Loyalty-program hotel in Solo (Surakarta), the Central Java royal city east of Yogyakarta.
intro: Solo's coverage in this directory is in Surakarta, the Central Java royal city about an hour east of Yogyakarta, known for its palaces, batik markets and traditional Javanese arts. A quieter, less touristy base than Yogyakarta, Solo is reached via Adisumarmo International Airport (SOC).
